summary: Colorado man in his twenties fell ill while hiking with his partner (a Utah woman in her thirties, former EMT) to ice climb the Ames Ice Hose via the Galloping Goose Trail near Ames, ~10 miles southwest of Telluride; they turned back after three hours when he became too sick to climb, and repeated nausea and vomiting plus suspected hypothermia (0-10 F) stalled their egress; the partner kept him moving and warm until a hasty team reached them just before 2 p.m.; snow-machine transport to a staging area at the Ames power plant and Telluride EMS transport to Telluride Medical Center
location: Galloping Goose Trail / Ames Ice Hose, near Ames
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office SAR; Telluride EMS
notes: Incident Wednesday 2015-12-30 per sheriff release; 911 call 12:15 p.m.; staged at Ames power plant
